result.title: Occupancy Modeling via Drifting: One-Step Generation Enables Direct Policy Extraction
result.summary: The growing interest in behavior foundation models, combined with recent advancements in generative modeling, has led to an appealing recipe for reinforcement learning from unlabeled data: pre-train a generative model to model occupancies, i.e., discounted state visitations, on reward-free trajectories, such that a policy can be easily extracted once a small reward-labeled dataset becomes available. We decompose this recipe along three axes: (i) the degree to which the multi-modal structure of occupancies must be captured, (ii) the class of generative model, and (iii) the method used for policy extraction. Along each axis, we consider existing choices, propose simpler alternatives, and validate each decision experimentally. This analysis culminates in a novel, streamlined method that leverages drifting, a modern one-step generative sampler, to model the occupancy. We show that this enables policy extraction via direct differentiation through the occupancy model, and bypasses the need for critic distillation. Overall, we observe that this nimble setup leads to improvements in performance on standard benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把「在无奖励轨迹上预训练生成式 occupancy（折扣状态访问分布），再用少量奖励数据抽取策略」这一流程拆成三条设计轴——多模态结构建模、生成模型类别与策略抽取方式，并据此提出用 drifting 一步生成采样建模 occupancy、通过直接求导抽取策略、免去 critic 蒸馏的简化方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其一步式 drifting 采样与「对生成模型直接求导」的抽取方式，可能为 diffusion/一步式 latent 推理状态生成、以及免蒸馏的监督与贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索；但该工作属强化学习，与视觉多模态推理无直接关系。
